# codebase-agent-os-demo

Conceptual AI-native OS demo. Donor of vApp / dashboard composition patterns.
Mostly inspirational.

## Stack & contents

Vanilla JS / HTML/CSS, no package.json. ~32 flat files including `app.js` through `app6.js` (numbered iterations) plus three QA-ROUND markdown reports and `.serena/` project metadata.

## Why this is here

Earliest browser-only Agent OS demo. Useful as a 'shape' donor: how an OS-like surface composes apps without any framework underneath. Don't lift code; lift layout patterns.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-demo:code/agent-os-demo/index.html
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-demo:code/agent-os-demo/AUDIT.md
```
